g.text: 500 English messages • 77 banking intents • real API calls
Latency includes network and schema validation. One outstanding call per provider, four providers in parallel.
Costs use reported charges where available; otherwise usage estimates or error reservations. Timing repeats and development excluded.
Failed calls count as incorrect. Latency is for valid answers only. One dataset, one host, one run.
